review.notes: Triage review of the 230-page document. (a) Structure: full fence scan of the OCR markdown is balanced (one legitimate ```txt transcript block on the physical pages around the prompt-injection section, no swallowed headings/tables/images); all 186 heading lines were cross-checked against the PDF text layer, which identified one misread heading word and 37 headings promoted from text that exists only inside figure/screenshot images (chart banners and transcript-screenshot titles); the ten level-1 duplicates collided with the document title level. Every demotion patch was verified on a rendered page (105-130 dpi contact sheets; the p.20 heading at 300 dpi). (b) Droppage: automated per-page normalized 4-gram containment between extracted PDF text and the OCR markdown flagged only the cover page and table/figure pages; inspected flagged pages (e.g. the physical p.174 capability-summary table) show the content fully present in OCR HTML tables with matching values, so the low ratio is cell-order tokenization, not dropped text. A document-wide scan for spaced digits in numbers found 0 hits. (c) 'USage Policy' on the physical p.56 sentence was confirmed at 300 dpi to be printed that way in the source PDF and was deliberately NOT corrected (source typo, not an OCR defect). Line-by-line reading was limited to flagged pages and heading/droppage hits; unflagged prose pages were covered only by the machine scans.
